notes:
WIN ($WIN): a "last buyer wins" game on a Uniswap v4 WIN/IMD pool.

TOKEN. WinToken: plain fixed-supply ERC-20, no constructor arguments, mints 1,000,000,000e18 once to its deployer. No owner, mint, pause, blocklist, transfer fee or upgrade path.

HOOK. WinGameHook(IPoolManager $poolManager, address $token). No owner, no setters, no DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT. getHookPermissions returns exactly the five flags listed (address bits 0x20CC). beforeInitialize is PoolManager-only, binds the hook to one pool that pairs $token with one other currency (IMD is read from the PoolKey), accepts LP fee 500/3000/10000 only and refuses a second pool. pool.fee 3000 / tickSpacing 60 is the real LP fee; the hook fee below is separate.

INITIAL PRICE - ORDERING CAVEAT. Target is a 2500 IMD market cap = 2.5e-6 IMD per WIN (both 18 decimals), snapped to the spacing-60 tick the test fixture uses, |tick| = 129000, i.e. 2499.66 IMD (0.014% under) so single-sided seeding has clean bounds. The value written, 125262255113908064987203232 = getSqrtPriceAtTick(-129000), is correct when WIN is currency0 (WIN address < IMD address). If the deployed WIN sorts above IMD, WIN is currency1 and the same price is tick +129000, sqrtPriceX96 50111677533496076234078224273595. The ordering is known only once the token is deployed and the schema has one field, so the deployer must apply the value for the actual ordering; the wrong one misprices WIN by about 1.6e11x. WIN-only range: [-128940, 887220] if WIN is currency0, [-887220, 128940] if currency1.

HOOK FEE. Always in IMD, for exact-input and exact-output buys and sells: 50% at pool initialization, falling linearly to 3% over 30 minutes (the brief's curve, kept). 90% to the bank, 10% to teamOwed; claimTeamFees() can pay only the constant wallet 0x611F08c7226591708B5F53F29BF53f3830D54511. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager, so the first buy works while the manager holds no IMD; payouts burn and take inside the hook's own unlock. The bank starts empty and leaves only as round prizes.

GAME. Qualifying buy: gross IMD >= minimumBuy() = max(8.5 IMD, 20% of the next prize) x 1.05^n (n = qualifying buys this round). It sets the leader and deadline = now + 10 min; round 1 cannot end before launch + 3 h. settle() is open to anyone after expiry: 20% of the bank in round 1, 5% afterwards, the rest stays. Sells never change leader or timer. A buy arriving after expiry first closes the round for its real leader (end-of-round snipe defence; that winner pulls with claimPrize). Buyer = address in hookData (abi.encode(address) or 20 packed bytes), else tx.origin; the website must pass hookData, and smart-account or relayed trades without it are credited to tx.origin. Views: gameState, bankBalance, nextPrize, minimumBuy, leader, timeLeft, roundNumber, pastWinners.

KNOWN LIMITS. Exact-input buys and exact-output sells that would fill partially revert (PartialFillNotSupported). Sells cannot execute until a buy has put IMD into the single-sided pool. IMD must be a plain ERC-20. Block stuffing is deterred economically only (full 10-minute reset, 5% prize, rising minimum).

OPEN. Tests use their own PoolManager and a mock IMD, in both token orderings; run on a fork they do not touch the chain's real PoolManager or IMD, so a rehearsal against those is still owed. docs/REVIEW.md is a self-review by the implementing contributor; the independent review the brief requires is still owed. Supply split and liquidity (90% to the pool single-sided, 0% to the requester, no IMD or ETH added) are launch-policy inputs and are not set by this file.
